headlines.title: 香港证监会：对耀才证券作出谴责并处以罚款280万港元
headlines.summary: 香港证监会对耀才证券国际（香港）有限公司（耀才）作出谴责并处以罚款280万港元，原因是该公司没有实施充足而有效的内部监控程序，以监察和侦测由其客户进行的清洗交易。香港证监会的调查发现，于2023年11月1日至2025年9月13日期间，由于耀才的内部监控措施不足，导致615个客户帐户执行了1,021对涉及736只股票及权证的清洗交易。香港证监会亦发现，由于耀才在2024年3月前主要依赖交易后监察及人手审查来识别可疑交易活动，客户因而得以在被侦测前进行清洗交易。（香港证监会网站）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC reprimands and fines Bright Smart Securities HK$2.8 million
headlines.summary_en: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has reprimanded and fined Bright Smart Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (Bright Smart) HK$2.8 million for failing to implement adequate and effective internal control procedures to monitor and detect wash trading conducted by its clients. An SFC investigation found that due to Bright Smart's inadequate internal controls, 615 client accounts executed 1,021 pairs of wash trades involving 736 stocks and warrants between 1 November 2023 and 13 September 2025. The SFC also found that as Bright Smart relied mainly on post-trade monitoring and manual reviews to identify suspicious trading activities before March 2024, clients were able to carry out wash trades before detection. (SFC website)

headlines.title: 外交部：今年上半年 中非贸易亮点纷呈
headlines.summary: 外交部发言人林剑主持例行记者会。有记者问，今年上半年中非贸易取得亮眼成绩，对非洲建交国全面实施零关税举措成效显著。请问发言人对此有何评论？ 林剑表示，今年上半年，中非贸易亮点纷呈。 一是总量加速跃升。中非的进出口商品总额达到1.41万亿元人民币，为历史同期最高，今年的贸易总额有望再上新台阶。二是结构持续优化。三是非洲对华出口潜力不断释放。（央视）

headlines.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China-Africa trade sees bright spots in first half of year
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Lin Jian held a regular press conference. A reporter asked about the outstanding performance of China-Africa trade in the first half of the year and the notable results of the zero-tariff policy implemented for all African countries having diplomatic relations with China. Lin Jian stated that China-Africa trade was vibrant in H1 2025: first, the total volume accelerated, with total imports and exports reaching 1.41 trillion yuan, a historical high for the period, and full-year trade is expected to reach a new level. Second, the structure continued to optimize. Third, the export potential of African countries to China continued to be unleashed. (CCTV)

headlines.title_en: Sino Biopharmaceutical forms joint venture with Indonesia's Tempo Scan
headlines.summary_en: China Biologic Products (1177.HK) announced that the Group has signed a joint venture agreement with Tempo Scan, listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, to jointly establish PT TEMPO CTTQ BIOPHARMACEUTICAL INDONESIA (TCBI). Under the agreement, China Biologic Products holds 51% of TCBI, and Tempo Scan holds 49%. TCBI will deeply integrate Tempo Scan's local expertise in the Indonesian market with its core advantages in innovative R&D and product pipelines, focusing on drug registration, clinical development, medical affairs, market access, and commercialization of a full range of drugs, and will assess the feasibility of local production in Indonesia in due course. Several products have already received approvals from local regulatory authorities or are in the registration review stage.

headlines.title_en: China Association for Public Companies: 71 new IPOs in first half of year, raising 70.574 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: The China Association for Public Companies released its June statistical report. Data shows that as of 30 June 2026, there were a total of 5,535 listed companies in the domestic stock market, with 2,314, 2,898, and 323 on the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing stock exchanges respectively. By share type, there were 5,263 companies issuing only A-shares, 265 companies with multiple share types such as A+H or A+B, and 7 companies issuing only B-shares.

headlines.title: 富途证券推出韩国股票直接交易服务
headlines.summary: 富途证券宣布韩股交易正式上线，中国香港地区和新加坡的合资格投资者，现可同步开启韩股交易。该服务涵盖韩国交易所（KRX）旗下KOSPI主板及KOSDAQ创业板超2700只股票，并提供韩国交易所盘前竞价时段交易。

headlines.title_en: Futu Securities launches direct trading service for Korean stocks
headlines.summary_en: Futu Securities announced the official launch of South Korean stock trading. Eligible investors in Hong Kong SAR and Singapore can now start trading South Korean stocks. The service covers over 2,700 stocks listed on the KOSPI main board and KOSDAQ growth board of the Korea Exchange (KRX), and offers pre-market auction trading on the Korea Exchange.

headlines.summary: 外交部发言人林剑主持例行记者会。有记者问，今年上半年中非贸易取得亮眼成绩，对非洲建交国全面实施零关税举措成效显著。请问发言人对此有何评论？ 林剑表示，今年上半年，中非贸易亮点纷呈。 一是总量加速跃升。中非的进出口商品总额达到1.41万亿元人民币，为历史同期最高，今年的贸易总额有望再上新台阶。二是结构持续优化。三是非洲对华出口潜力不断释放。（央视）
